deployment.name: kubernetes
deployment.rule: Use Kustomize with a shared `base` and one overlay per environment. Overlays should only contain what differs between environments.
The manifests and the rest of the deployment scripts and conf will be in the `/deploy` folder.
Keep one folder per application or service, with one resource kind per file such as `deployment.yaml`, `service.yaml`, and `ingress.yaml`.
Write the long, explicit syntax in manifests for clarity.
Load environment variables from a ConfigMap and a Secret per application. Generate them from that application's env files instead of merging all variables into one.
Never commit real secret values. Commit only example files with dummy values or descriptions.
Pin image tags. Do not use `latest`.
Set resource requests and limits, and readiness and liveness probes, for every container.
Run database migrations as a Job, not inside application containers at startup.
deployment.example_deploy_folder: ``` ├── deploy │ ├── base │ │ ├── kustomization.yaml │ │ ├── namespace.yaml │ │ ├── api │ │ │ ├── kustomization.yaml │ │ │ ├── deployment.yaml │ │ │ ├── service.yaml │ │ │ └── migrate-job.yaml │ │ ├── dashboard │ │ │ ├── kustomization.yaml │ │ │ ├── deployment.yaml │ │ │ └── service.yaml │ │ └── postgres │ │ ├── kustomization.yaml │ │ ├── statefulset.yaml │ │ └── service.yaml │ └── overlays │ ├── dev │ │ ├── kustomization.yaml │ │ ├── patches │ │ │ └── api-resources.yaml │ │ └── env │ │ ├── api.env.example │ │ └── dashboard.env.example │ └── prod │ ├── kustomization.yaml │ ├── ingress.yaml │ ├── patches │ │ ├── api-replicas.yaml │ │ └── api-resources.yaml │ └── env │ ├── api.env.example │ └── dashboard.env.example ```
